about_pullquote: We climb trees other people are afraid of, and we do it safely every single time.
about_para_1: Andrews Tree Company was founded on the principle that tree work should be done right — not rushed or cut corners. With nearly two decades in Bristol's gardens, we've built a reputation for tackling jobs others won't touch. Whether it's a 60-foot oak overhanging your roof or a tangle of storm-damaged branches, we show up with the right equipment and the skill to finish it properly.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we're straight with them: we quote fairly, explain what we're doing, and leave the site spotless. We're fully insured and abide by arboricultural standards — that's not negotiable. From a routine prune to emergency removals at midnight, we treat your garden as if it's our own.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak limb hanging over the house after the winter storms. Andrews came out within hours, assessed it safely, and had it down and cleared by end of day. Brilliant work, very professional. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been getting them to maintain our hedge for three years now. Always arrive on time, tidy up properly, and the hedge looks immaculate. They're a bit dearer than some, but you get what you pay for — real expertise.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Absolute nightmare overgrown tree in the garden. Got a quote from Andrews, thought it fair, and they turned up with all the gear and took it down in one morning without a mess. Very competent lads. Strongly recommend.
reviews.author: David C.
